alerte.texte: Your vote fix is reviewed with zero defects and green: it merges right after the test loop. The full review of everything since build 196 found no defect so far on the server and on most screens, and nothing that could break build 196.

depuis.texte: Server, outside the app: trace reports keep only their redacted copy, never the original.
Hick's law point 10: the composer has a single sound button. Tap the mic to record, long-press it to import a sound.
CI: the secret scan can no longer be skipped by its cache, and every step has a time limit.
App: when a screen's answer breaks its contract, the app reports which screen and field (never any data), instead of a silent « Couldn't load ».
Hick's law point 8: the map keeps a single arrow, « Around you » gets a list icon, and « Search here » appears when you move the map.
Website: notifications are marked read only up to what you actually saw; « Read all » had no limit at all.
Test only: website tests wait for React to finish before removing their page, which ends random « window is not defined » failures.
Server: traces of a withdrawn vote are forgotten after a minute, as the code says, instead of about an hour.
Test only: two flaky security tests run on a frozen clock, and a rule nobody tested is now tested.
Test only: the avatar editor's flaky tests drive their own clock.
Test only: a flaky KnowMe test on the website now holds its own timers instead of the real clock.
Test loop: on a Mac without cloud storage, the Takes tab no longer shows « Couldn't load »; an image the contract refuses is just left out.
Team only: first step of a performance patrol, a measurement chain marked advisory.
Team only: an observability console, with its screens and a browser SDK for the website and the console.
Private profile: a locked profile now shows Friends, Takes and Score. Your TestFlight point.
Hick's law point 12: in search, « Sort by » stays only on the Top tab; Latest, Photos and Videos keep Date and From.
Hick's law point 3: the sign-in sheet has no cross any more, only « Later » and a swipe down.
CI: the picture check of pull requests no longer takes a bot's logo for a screenshot; only real pictures count.
CI: the app's page names are finally type-checked, so a link to a page that does not exist can no longer pass.
Server: checks of curated videos no longer call the video sites in bursts after a delay; they stay 50 ms apart.
Test loop: the development seed now writes everything the regression loop needs, so no more manual catch-up after each seed.
CI only: the nightly route sweep may now write its tracking tickets.
Messages: a thread opened from a notification now goes back to your inbox with Back, like X and Instagram.
Messages: tapping the Messages tab from inside a thread always lands on your inbox, clearing the threads opened on top.
Website: documents always show in the chosen language, and the welcome page is no longer fetched ahead of time.
A lint rule now blocks the two ways of opening a page that skipped the double-tap guard. Found by the Hick's law audit.
Every pull request that changes the app must now show it breaks nothing (its regression study), or a check fails. Your request of 10/10.
Profile song chip and picker on mobile and web

On the map search, picking a suggestion writes its name in the bar, ready to be written over; the places follow the typing sooner and the flight takes 1.2 s instead of 2.4. Your TestFlight point; for the next build.

Messages and the Profile are prepared ahead while you rest on Amis, switched off by default. Measured on a cloud iPhone: off, it costs nothing; on, it slows nothing and makes launch lighter (12 network reads instead of 22). For the next build.
An official Take's video is removed only when the video site says it is gone twice, a day apart; one passing error no longer removes it for good. It reaches staging with the next server deploy.

claude.libelle: A Claude is fixing it here

enCours.ouEnEst: Fixed for the feed, where you filmed it, and for the opened Take: a late read can no longer hide your vote. Reviews found three more edge cases (anonymity, a read sent while the vote travels). All are fixed, the last review found zero defects, and CI is green.
enCours.reste: Merge right after the test loop.

enCours.sujet: Your conversation that freezes 2 s on a cold start
enCours.ouEnEst: The conversation screen is now prepared while you look at Messages. A review found it could stutter during a scroll of the inbox: fixed, it waits for the list to rest. Second review in progress.
enCours.reste: Measure on a Replicas iPhone in Release, then merge.

enCours.ouEnEst: A full rehearsal of the regression loop on the Mac. First pass: flows 1 to 8 green, then an iOS camera permission alert on a fresh simulator stopped flow 9 (not a regression: nothing changed touches the camera). Restarted at 06:35 with permissions granted.
enCours.reste: Any red flow gets its ticket right away.

enCours.sujet: Full review of everything changed since build 196
enCours.ouEnEst: Three Replicas machines re-read every change, zone by zone. Server and contract: no defect, and nothing can break build 196 for its testers. Messages, profile, Explore, map and composer: no defect in 56 files. Feed, vote and navigation: in progress.
enCours.reste: Anything found is fixed before the build.

enCours.sujet: Ready to merge after the loop
enCours.ouEnEst: Green and reviewed: old builds ignore new server fields, unknown cards are skipped instead of blanking a list, the composer with its extra renders removed, and Expert notes read less often.
enCours.reste: Merge as soon as the loop ends.

enCours.ouEnEst: Your still panel, plus an Android fix found in review: the back key closes the keyboard and the panel shrinks back. A last iOS detail is being fixed.
enCours.reste: Android picture on Replicas, then merge.

enCours.sujet: Mentions in the most likely order
enCours.ouEnEst: Reviewed. One picture is being redone on a single database: the first one was taken on another database.
enCours.reste: Picture, then merge, then the faster mentions.

enCours.ouEnEst: Reviewed. One picture at the largest text size is being redone on a Replicas iPhone.
Expert notes are no longer re-read every minute on a Take that has none, and your Profile counters are re-read after 2 minutes instead of 30 s. A third idea was dropped: the app already did it.

enCours.sujet: Explore pages going blank during quick changes
enCours.ouEnEst: A Replicas machine builds it and takes the pictures and the measurement on a cloud iPhone.
A Replicas machine measures it in Release, data size included.

enCours.sujet: A late database copy could show an old anonymity
enCours.ouEnEst: Found while fixing your vote, and it already exists today: right after you switch to anonymous, a lagging database copy could show your vote as public for a moment. Fix on the server: for 30 s after you vote, your own reads come from the main database.
enCours.reste: Measured on staging behind a switch, then turned on. Not part of the app build.

enCours.ouEnEst: 15 options on the page; you said you will tell me later.
enCours.reste: Your choice, then a Claude builds it.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me, five Claude agents (fixes and reviews), and audit-hick running the test loop. Your emulator is switched off during the loop to save memory.

On Replicas, on Muse Spark through OpenCode: renard, belette and lemming (full review by zone, then pictures and a missing test), vison (videos ahead), harfang (Explore fix), wombat (pictures, then the conversation measurement). Claude is still rate-limited on Replicas, and two machines fail on their fallback.
etapes: Finish the test loop on the Mac, then merge everything green and reviewed.
Finish your conversation fix: second review, then the iPhone measurement.
Last pictures (mentions, welcome screen, map on Android), then merge.
Measure and merge the videos ahead and the Explore fix.
Then the full regression loop on the exact build-197 commit, the list of what is in and out, and your OK.
